ov: The largest waterfowl, and among the largest flying birds in their range, with six living species. Northern Hemisphere swans are pure white; southern ones are black or black and white.

why.dg: Mute swans can be very aggressive defending their nests, hissing and then striking with bony spurs on their wings and biting.

rg: Europe, Asia and North America, plus the black swan of Australia.
df: Almost entirely plants: the roots, tubers, stems and leaves of water plants, with a few small animals.

cf.tip: Swans, geese and ducks are one family; swans are the largest waterfowl, and ducks the smallest and shortest-necked.

fx: In Britain, marked mute swans were once registered with the Crown, and any unmarked swan became Crown property.
